tools.name: search_templates
tools.title: Search legal templates
tools.description: Searches the public catalog of Bulgarian legal document templates by keyword. Returns slug, name, category and purpose so the user can navigate to /shablon/<slug> or start a wizard.

query.description: Keyword to match against template name/purpose/category (Bulgarian or English).

tools.name: list_my_documents
tools.title: List my saved documents
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's saved legal documents (contracts, blanks, uploads) with id, title, kind and last-updated timestamp. Newest first.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return (1-50, default 20).

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter document titles.

tools.name: get_my_document
tools.title: Get one of my documents
tools.description: Fetches the full content of one of the signed-in user's saved documents by id. Returns title, kind, and the JSON payload with clauses/fields.

id.description: UUID of the saved document (use list_my_documents to find it).

tools.name: list_my_contacts
tools.title: List my contacts
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's saved contacts (individuals and companies used as counterparties in documents). Optional search filter on name/EIK/email.

search.description: Optional substring to filter by name, EIK or email.
